king_veer.label: King Veer
king_veer.visual_dna: A 45-year-old Indian king with a neatly trimmed black and grey beard, shoulder-length dark hair, sharp brown eyes, a golden crown with a red ruby, deep maroon royal robes with gold embroidery, broad shoulders and a stern but thoughtful expression.

queen_meera.label: Queen Meera
queen_meera.visual_dna: A 38-year-old Indian queen with expressive dark eyes, long black hair in a braided bun, a royal blue and gold saree, elegant gold jewelry, a small crescent-shaped forehead ornament and a calm, intelligent expression.

prince_aarav.label: Prince Aarav
prince_aarav.visual_dna: A 19-year-old Indian prince with a youthful face, short wavy black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a cream and royal blue embroidered tunic, a simple gold pendant and an observant expression.

captain_arya.label: Captain Arya
captain_arya.visual_dna: A 32-year-old female palace guard captain with an athletic build, focused eyes, dark hair tied in a tight bun, bronze and navy armor, a red shoulder sash and a sword at her waist.

royal_palace.label: Royal Palace
royal_palace.visual_dna: A magnificent medieval Indian palace with sandstone walls, carved pillars, grand balconies, colorful glass windows, royal banners, golden lamps and a vast central courtyard.

throne_room.label: Throne Room
throne_room.visual_dna: A grand royal courtroom with a raised golden throne, maroon carpet, tall carved pillars, large arched windows and a circular stone emblem in the center of the floor.

palace_archive.label: Royal Archive
palace_archive.visual_dna: A quiet palace archive filled with wooden shelves, rolled scrolls, old royal records, brass lamps and a large writing desk.

old_bridge.label: Old Stone Bridge
old_bridge.visual_dna: An ancient stone bridge over a deep river gorge, with weathered railings, carved pillars, steep rocky banks and a narrow path leading toward the palace.

royal_dagger.label: Royal Dagger
royal_dagger.visual_dna: A short ceremonial dagger with a silver blade, a blue gemstone in its golden hilt and a tiny engraved royal crest.

broken_crown.label: Broken Crown
broken_crown.visual_dna: A small golden royal crown with one side bent and a missing blue gemstone, showing signs of an old impact.

sealed_letter.label: Sealed Letter
sealed_letter.visual_dna: An old parchment letter folded twice and closed with dark red wax bearing the royal lion emblem.

beats.narration_text: जिस दिन राजा वीर ने अपने बेटे को देशद्रोही कहा, उसी दिन पूरे दरबार में सन्नाटा छा गया।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer standing before his golden throne, pointing accusingly toward Prince Aarav in the middle of the royal courtroom. Ministers and guards watch in shock.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The prince stands alone in the center of the court.

beats.narration_text: आरोप था कि राजकुमार ने राजा की हत्या की कोशिश की थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show the royal dagger lying on a red velvet cushion before the throne, its blue gemstone hilt clearly visible.
beats.session_delta_prompt: A small dark stain is visible near the blade's tip.

beats.narration_text: और सबसे बड़ा सबूत था, राजा के कमरे में मिला यही खंजर।
beats.prompt_action: Show Prince Aarav staring at the dagger from across the courtroom, his face pale and confused.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His eyes remain fixed on the dagger.

beats.narration_text: राजकुमार ने कहा, मैंने ऐसा कुछ नहीं किया।
beats.prompt_action: Show Prince Aarav raising one hand in protest, looking directly toward his father with hurt and disbelief.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His expression is desperate but controlled.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन राजा ने उसे उसी शाम जेल भेजने का आदेश दे दिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer seated rigidly on the throne, one hand raised as he gives the order to the guards.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The guards begin moving toward the prince.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन रानी मीरा को अपने बेटे की बात पर भरोसा था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera standing beside a palace pillar, watching the prince being taken away, her face full of concern but not doubt.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Her eyes follow her son.

beats.narration_text: उसने राजा से बस एक रात माँगी।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera standing before King Veer in a quiet palace chamber, asking him for time with one hand raised.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The king listens without changing his expression.

beats.narration_text: रानी ने कहा, अगर वह दोषी है, तो मैं खुद सज़ा दूँगी।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera looking firmly at the king, her posture straight and her expression determined.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The king looks at her in silence.

beats.narration_text: राजा ने आखिरकार उसे सुबह तक का समय दे दिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer giving a reluctant nod, seated beside a carved palace window.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His face remains stern.

beats.narration_text: रानी सबसे पहले राजा के कमरे में पहुँची।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera walking briskly through the royal corridor toward the king's private chamber, accompanied by no one.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Her blue and gold saree moves as she walks.

beats.narration_text: वहाँ उसे खंजर के पास एक टूटा हुआ मुकुट मिला।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera's hand picking up {assets.broken_crown} from the stone floor beside an empty velvet dagger stand.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The missing gemstone setting catches the light.

beats.narration_text: वह मुकुट राजकुमार का नहीं, राजा का था।
beats.prompt_action: Show the broken crown in Queen Meera's palm, with the tiny royal lion crest engraved on its inner band.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The crest is sharply visible.

beats.narration_text: रानी को याद आया कि राजा ने पिछली रात मुकुट पहना ही नहीं था।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer from the previous evening standing in his chamber without his crown, wearing his maroon royal robes.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The empty crown stand is visible in the background.

beats.narration_text: अब रानी को शक हुआ कि किसी ने सबूत जानबूझकर रखा था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera studying the broken crown on the archive desk, her eyes narrowed as she considers the evidence.
beats.session_delta_prompt: She turns the crown slightly in her hand.

beats.narration_text: उसने पुराने पहरेदारों का रजिस्टर मँगवाया।
beats.prompt_action: Show an old palace guard register opened on a wooden archive desk, with Queen Meera's hand turning a brittle page.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Rows of handwritten entries fill the page.

beats.narration_text: रजिस्टर में लिखा था कि रात को राजा के कमरे में सिर्फ एक आदमी गया था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera reading one entry in the register, her finger resting beside a single visitor's name.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The name is partly covered by her fingertip.

beats.narration_text: वह आदमी था, राजमहल का सबसे भरोसेमंद सेनापति।
beats.prompt_action: Show the register entry clearly indicating Captain Arya's predecessor, General Bhairav, as the only visitor recorded that night.
beats.session_delta_prompt: A royal stamp appears beside the entry.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन सेनापति तो पाँच साल पहले मर चुका था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera staring at the register in disbelief, her fingers tightening around the page.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Her expression shifts from curiosity to alarm.

beats.narration_text: रानी ने उसी रात का एक और रिकॉर्ड खोजा।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera pulling a second old ledger from a high wooden shelf in the archive.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Dust falls from the book's cover.

beats.narration_text: उसमें लिखा था कि सेनापति की मौत नदी वाले पुल पर हुई थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show an old official death record open on the desk, with a hand-drawn illustration of the stone bridge and a date beside it.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The date is visible beside the bridge drawing.

beats.narration_text: और उसी तारीख के नीचे किसी ने राजा के हस्ताक्षर किए थे।
beats.prompt_action: Show a close-up of the king's signature at the bottom of the old death record, with a faint ink smudge beside it.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The signature looks unusually shaky.

beats.narration_text: रानी समझ गई कि उस मौत की कहानी में कुछ गड़बड़ थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show the ancient stone bridge over a deep river gorge at dusk, with the palace visible far in the distance.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The bridge looks deserted.

beats.narration_text: वह पुराने पुल पर पहुँची, जहाँ सेनापति की मौत बताई गई थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera walking alone onto the old stone bridge, holding a small lantern.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Her footsteps echo across the empty bridge.

beats.narration_text: पुल के किनारे उसे पत्थर में फँसा एक छोटा तीर मिला।
beats.prompt_action: Show a tiny metal arrowhead lodged between two weathered stones along the bridge railing.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The arrowhead has a small blue thread tied around it.

beats.narration_text: उस तीर पर वही नीला धागा था, जो राजकुमार के कपड़ों पर लगा था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera holding the small arrowhead with its blue thread, comparing it to a loose blue thread from Prince Aarav's royal tunic.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The two blue threads match in color and weave.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन यह धागा राजकुमार के कपड़ों से नहीं, उसके पुराने तीर-कमान से आता था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera realizing the distinction, holding the arrowhead in one hand and looking toward the palace in the distance.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Her expression becomes sharply focused.

beats.narration_text: किसी ने राजकुमार का सामान इस्तेमाल करके उसे फँसाया था।
beats.prompt_action: Show a small royal archery case lying open on a palace storage shelf, with one arrow missing.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The empty slot in the case is clearly visible.

beats.narration_text: अब रानी के पास झूठ पकड़ने का एक तरीका था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera holding the old record and arrowhead together, her face calm and determined.
beats.session_delta_prompt: She turns back toward the palace.

beats.narration_text: सुबह होते ही रानी ने पूरे दरबार को फिर बुलाया।
beats.prompt_action: Show the royal courtroom filled with ministers, guards and courtiers as Queen Meera enters through the tall carved doors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: All eyes turn toward the queen.

beats.narration_text: उसने राजा से पूछा, क्या आपको याद है कि सेनापति की मौत किस दिन हुई थी?
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera standing before King Veer, holding the old death record and asking him a direct question.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The king looks down at the document.

beats.narration_text: राजा ने कहा, उस दिन मैं राजधानी में था ही नहीं।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer looking surprised and answering firmly from his throne.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His eyes move toward the old record.

beats.narration_text: रानी ने तुरंत वह रिकॉर्ड सबके सामने रख दिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera placing the old death record on the central courtroom table, its royal signature facing the assembled ministers.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The courtiers lean forward to inspect it.

beats.narration_text: कागज़ पर राजा के हस्ताक्षर थे, जबकि राजा वहाँ था ही नहीं।
beats.prompt_action: Show the old record and the king's signature in sharp focus, with the king's hand visible in the background.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The contradiction is visually clear.

beats.narration_text: तभी राजा ने एक और बात बताई, उस रात उसका मुकुट भी गायब था।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer leaning forward on his throne, speaking with a grave expression as he remembers the missing crown.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His hand grips the armrest.

beats.narration_text: रानी ने सेनापति का नाम लिया, और दरबार में बैठे एक बूढ़े मंत्री का चेहरा सफेद पड़ गया।
beats.prompt_action: Show an elderly minister in dark green robes suddenly going pale among the seated courtiers, his eyes fixed on Queen Meera.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His fingers tighten around his walking stick.

beats.narration_text: रानी ने कहा, सेनापति मरा नहीं था, उसे नई पहचान देकर महल में छिपाया गया था।
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera pointing toward the elderly minister, while the court turns toward him in shock.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The minister takes a small step backward.

beats.narration_text: उस बूढ़े मंत्री ने भागने की कोशिश की, लेकिन सैनिकों ने उसे पकड़ लिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show two palace guards grabbing the elderly minister as he tries to rush toward the courtroom doors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: His walking stick falls to the floor.

beats.narration_text: राजा ने अपने बेटे को गले लगाया, लेकिन रानी की नज़र अब भी उस मंत्री पर थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show King Veer embracing Prince Aarav in front of the throne, while Queen Meera watches the arrested minister in the background.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The prince closes his eyes in relief.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि मंत्री के हाथ में वही नीला धागा बँधा था, जो पुल पर मिला था।
beats.prompt_action: Show the elderly minister's wrist held by a guard, revealing a short blue thread tied around it.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The blue thread matches the one found on the arrowhead.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन अगर मंत्री ही सेनापति था, तो पाँच साल तक राजा के इतने करीब कौन रहा?
beats.prompt_action: Show Queen Meera looking toward the viewer with a troubled, questioning expression, the arrested minister blurred behind her.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Hold on the queen's unsettled expression, leaving the mystery unresolved.
